title: Negative Ion/Anti-5g Products Are Actually RADIOACTIVE
summary: The Thought Emporium tests so-called negative ion and anti-5G wellness products and finds they are radioactive, with some coated in powdered thorium.
why: HN cites it as the debunking behind news stories about radioactive anti-5G pendants and wellness trinkets sold on Amazon.

quote.text: the maker went to debunk the negative ion energy bands, only to discover some of them had highly dangerous powdered thorium coating them.
